title: Federated learning method and system based on dual-end security protection

pse.problem: Security risk in federal learning due to manipulated or hijacked clients causing data poisoning attacks against training data, which cannot be directly reviewed by the server due to privacy protection principles.
pse.solution_function: The system filters local client data and calculates local model abnormality degrees. It uses a credibility score to determine the aggregation weight of each local model during federal aggregation.
pse.solution_structure: The system includes a data filter, a server for feature extraction, history information saving, model filter based on probability distribution, and a classification self-encoder for training data filtering.
pse.solution_implementation: The server receives local models and data descriptions from each client. It filters the local data, extracts features, saves client history information, and calculates local model abnormality degrees using the model filter. The credibility score is determined based on the local data description and local model abnormality degree for each client. The server trains the data filter using a classification self-encoder with main task test data.
pse.effect: The system enhances the security and robustness of federal learning by detecting and mitigating potential attacks aiming at local training data and processes, thus improving the global quality of federal learning main tasks.
